description: Leaf base that wraps around or clasps the stem, without forming a fully sheathing base.
notes: Distinct from sheathing (fully encircles stem) and auriculate/sagittate (ear-/arrow-shaped lobes at base) - none of the existing allowed values captured a base that clasps without lobes or a full sheath. First encountered in Andersonia axilliflora ("broad; clasps at the stem").

description: A mid-brown seed colour, distinct from the darker red_brown option already in seed_colour's allowed values.
notes: seed_colour's existing allowed values (blue_purple/green/pink/red_brown/white_cream/yellow_orange/grey/black) have no plain 'brown' option, only the redder 'red_brown' - a plain 'brown' seed description was being force-mapped to red_brown at only medium confidence across several species (e.g. acacia_curranii, acacia_ammophila).
Companion value to 'brown' above, for seeds explicitly described as dark brown rather than a mid-tone.
